name: receipt-unsupported-version
description: A receipt for the uploaded bundle declaring receipt_version 3, canonically encoded and correctly signed by the pinned server key.
asserts: A receipt in a schema this implementation does not read is refused as unsupported, even though the signature is genuine: it cannot be known that a field this reader understands still means what it did. parse_error names the reason; the expectation's other fields only say that nothing here acknowledges the upload.
